verdict.rationale: The docs show strong cluster-scale operations tooling: communication primitives, a Kubernetes GPU Operator, a Slurm-compatible scheduler, an end-to-end AI cluster validation suite, a container toolkit, and vLLM/SGLang inference recipes. A community benchmark also confirms 8-GPU tensor-parallel (TP8) serving on MI355X. However, the pack never documents the interconnect itself (Infinity Fabric link bandwidth or topology) or any specific multi-GPU or rack-scale system configuration beyond a 'high density infrastructures' claim. Missing for 10: documented Infinity Fabric/interconnect bandwidth and topology, multi-GPU node and rack-scale system specs, and evidence of large-scale training deployments.
